title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text: ‘Underlines that Article II (e) of the UN Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide defines acts committed with intent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial or religious group, including through the forcible transfer of children belonging to one national or ethnic group to another group, as acts constituting genocide which are punishable;’
